message.content: An illustration of a magazine cover features a large white title "TEMPO" across the top. Below the title, a man's face and hands are depicted. He has light skin, graying hair, a mustache, and wears glasses with thin frames. He is smiling, showing his teeth. His head is surrounded by many layered, autumn-colored leaves in shades of orange, yellow, and red, which appear to sprout from his head like hair or a crown. His hands are visible below his face, holding a pair of black binoculars. A silver ring is on the ring finger of his left hand. The background consists entirely of the same multicolored leaves. In the upper right, text reads "POLITISASI KASUS CENTURY". Centered on the right is the bold white text "BERBURU KURSI WAPRES". The bottom left displays "RP 35.000", a website URL, and a barcode. The bottom right corner has the name "Jusuf Kalla". In the upper right corner, beneath the title, the date "12-18 MEI 2014" is visible. A red border frame is visible on the left side.
